releaseNotes:
v2.33.0 — items display, VIP gift fix, battery, Unity Ads, seasonal countdown, cloud restore
• Items bar: shows '4 left' only, no more duplicate x4 badge
• VIP daily gift: fixed race condition ensuring inbox item is always added (NonCancellable)
• Inbox: VIP 'next reward' countdown timer (HH:MM:SS until midnight)
• Battery: WorkManager notification jobs skip when battery is critically low
• Ads: Unity Ads 4.x integrated (RealAdManager); 'Watch Ad → 1 Free Life' in no-lives dialog
• Seasonal packs: days-left countdown chip + info ℹ️ button showing rules and end date
• Cloud saves: syncFromCloud() now called on startup to restore progress after reinstall
• Cloud saves: mergeProgress now covers all fields (VIP, items, seasonal levels, milestones, stars)
